references.text: The description of the clans of the Gershonites and their responsibilities in tabernacle service, which forms the basis for the census in chapter 4.
The earlier command to count the sons of Gershon by their clans and families, to which this verse refers as the result.
The continuation providing the total number of the Gershonites who were counted.
A later census of the Levites, including the descendants of the Gershonites.
The sons of Levi are mentioned, including Gershon, and the sons of Gershon are listed as the basis for the genealogical division.
